shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && printf '\\n--- ticket ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && printf '\\n--- round brief ---\\n' && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; else echo '(absent)'; fi && printf '\\n--- dod ---\\n' && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && printf '\\n--- acceptance excerpt ---\\n' && nl -ba src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '1,240p' && printf '\\n--- spec excerpt ---\\n' && nl -ba specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md | sed -n '1,90p' && printf '\\n--- package scripts ---\\n' && node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify(p.scripts,null,2))\" && printf '\\n--- link helper ---\\n' && if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then echo yes; else echo no; fi"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git diff --check && git diff -- src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git commit -m "Fix CI checks for non-Error hook coverage" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git status --short --branch'
